
{{alias}}( str[, reviver] )
    Attempts to parse a JSON-like string into a valid JavaScript object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    str: string
        String to parse.

    reviver: Function (optional)
        Transformation function.

    Returns
    -------
    out: any|Error
        Parsed value or an error.

    Examples
    --------
    > var obj = {{alias}}( '{ beep: "boop"}' )
    { 'beep': 'boop' }

    // Provide a reviver:
    > function reviver( key, value ) {
    ...     if ( key === '' ) { return value; }
    ...     if ( key === 'beep' ) { return value; }
    ... };
    > var str = '{ beep: "boop", a: "b" }';
    > var out = {{alias}}( str, reviver )
    { 'beep': 'boop' }

    See Also
    --------
